name: supahost
description: Manage your short-term rentals in Supahost: bookings, guest conversations, cleaning tasks, door codes, guest journeys and revenue for the organization you connect.

interface.longDescription:
Supahost is an AI guest-messaging and operations platform for short-term rental hosts and property managers. It works on top of your PMS or channel manager: messages and bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com and other channels land in one inbox, where Autopilot, the AI assistant, answers guests.

Ask "Who checks in tomorrow?", "Why did the AI answer this guest that way?" or "How fast did we reply last month, and how much did Autopilot handle?" - and act on the answer without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:
Bookings & calendar: arrivals, departures and the daily schedule; availability and rates; quote, create or cancel direct bookings
Guest inbox: search guests, read conversations, draft or send replies, message many guests at once, review AI phone-call transcripts
Autopilot: set the AI mode per listing, see why it replied, teach it answers, add escalation rules, tune tone and hours, review pending learnings
Guest journey: edit automatic welcome, check-in and checkout messages, preview them for a booking, cancel one or send it now
Guides & documents: turn a PDF or web page into check-in guides and guidebooks, publish them, manage rental agreements guests sign
Operations: edit listing details and house rules in Supahost, log and assign tasks, write turnover cleaning briefs, set owner, cleaner and maintenance contacts
Performance: revenue, occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, channel mix, reply speed, Autopilot share and estimated hours saved
Extras & readiness: paid extras like late checkout, website chat settings, door codes for key boxes and keypads, and read-only payment, registration and lock status

Requires a Supahost account; connect via OAuth sign-in. An owner or manager approves the organization and permissions ChatGPT gets; a connection sees only that one organization. ChatGPT sends a guest message only after you confirm the recipient and wording, and many of its changes can be undone. Payment setup, registration setup and smart-lock connection stay in the Supahost app.
capabilities: Read and draft replies to guest conversations
Create and update cleaning and maintenance tasks
Set up and check door codes
Manage guest-journey messages and AI knowledge
defaultPrompt: Which guest conversations are waiting for a reply?
How much revenue did we make this month?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo organization's bookings with a check-in date of today (guest name, property, dates). If there are none, says so without inventing any.

positive.description: Find conversations waiting for a reply
positive.prompt: Which guest conversations in Supahost are waiting for a reply? Show me the last message of each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the unanswered conversations of the demo organization with the guest's latest message for each.

positive.description: Draft a reply without sending it
positive.prompt: Draft a reply in Supahost to Alex Johnson about the check-in time. Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a draft reply to Alex Johnson grounded in the conversation and the property's check-in time, and saves it as a draft in the Supahost inbox. Nothing is sent to the guest.

positive.prompt: Create a cleaning task for the Demo Property in Madrid for tomorrow at 11:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one cleaning task on the Demo Property (Madrid) dated tomorrow at 11:00 in the property's time zone and returns it with a link to the task.

positive.prompt: How much revenue did we make this month in Supahost?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the demo organization's revenue for the current month, with the currency and the period it covers.

negative.prompt: Set up Stripe payouts in Supahost so guests can pay me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not set anything up and calls no payment-setup tool (none is listed). May call get_payments_status to report the current state, then tells the host that Stripe payments are set up in the Supahost app.

negative.description: Guest registration setup is not exposed
negative.prompt: Register all of this week's guests with the police in Supahost.
negative.expected_behavior: Files nothing with the police: no registration-setup tool is listed. May read get_registration_status or list_registration_gaps, then says registration is configured and sent from the Supahost app.

negative.prompt: Show me the bookings of another company's organization in Supahost.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses: the connection only sees the one organization it was granted for, so it returns no other company's bookings and does not try to guess or search for them.

review.commerce_description: Hosts can create and manage paid extras (upsells) and their per-listing prices from ChatGPT. Charging guests needs Stripe payments, which are set up in the Supahost app. No money moves through ChatGPT: nothing is bought by, or charged to, the ChatGPT user.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: bookings, guests, guest conversations with drafts and confirmed sends, cleaning and maintenance tasks, door codes, guest-journey messages, AI knowledge, and revenue and messaging performance for the connected Supahost organization.
